models.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed
models.description: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed is the faster variant of K3.1 Pro, a multimodal reasoning model for coding, 3D creation, document analysis and multi-step tool use. It supports a 1M-token context window and text, image and video inputs. Reasoning is always enabled, with low, high and max effort levels.

models.name: Xing 4.0 29B A4B
models.description: China Telecom’s Xing 4.0 is an Apache 2.0 open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 29B total and 4B active parameters, designed for coding, reasoning and tool use. Supports text input, structured output and a shared 262,144-token input/output context. This route does not use a TEE.

models.name: Abliterated Large Flash
models.description: Abliterated Large Flash is an uncensored reasoning model based on DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017. It accepts text and images and returns text, with tool calling, JSON mode, JSON Schema output, and automatic prompt caching. Its shared input/output context is 1,048,576 tokens, with up to 262,144 output tokens when space permits. Reasoning defaults to high and can be turned off or set to low, high, or max. Supports up to four images across the request history.

models.name: Ternary Bonsai2 9B
models.description: Ternary Bonsai2 9B is Prism ML’s open-weight model derived from Qwen3.5-9B with ternary language weights. It accepts text and generates text, supports reasoning and tool calling, and offers a shared 262,144-token context window with up to 65,536 output tokens. Thinking is enabled by default and can be turned off.
